tools.name: find_practice
tools.description: Offer the person up to three Mosaya practices they can do right here (meditation, breathwork, mindfulness, loving-kindness, gratitude, a focus timer and more). Use when they want to meditate, calm down, settle a racing mind, sleep, focus, or ask for a practice by name. Shows a card; nothing is store

tools.name: start_practice
tools.description: Open one Mosaya practice, ready to begin: the person picks a length, taps Begin, and the sit runs full screen with a bell at the start and the end, then a short celebration. Use after find_practice, or when they name a practice. Nothing is stored.
